content.careerPath:
This occupational profile specifies the duties and tasks required to become a Computer Maintenance Technician in the ICT industry.
• Career paths include:
• Manager ASCO 2153031
• Chief Technician ASCO 3114212
• Computer Network Technician ASCO 7252013
• Technician Helper ASCO 215 3031

performanceSteps: Review work instructions and site safety rules before starting.
Identify hazards in the work area.
Select, inspect and wear the required PPE.
Check tools and equipment for safe condition before use.
Prepare and secure the work area (signs, barriers, housekeeping).
Perform the work following safe procedures, including isolation and lockout/tagout where required.
Report hazards, incidents and near misses to the supervisor.
Clean up the work area and store tools and materials safely.
requiredKnowledge: Occupational safety and health rules and regulations.
Types of workplace hazards (physical, chemical, electrical, mechanical, ergonomic).
Meaning of safety signs and colours.
Emergency, first aid and fire procedures.
requiredSkills: Identify hazards and assess the risk level.
Inspect tools and equipment before use.
basicReading: Read safety signs, labels and work instructions.
Read safety data sheets (SDS) for chemicals used in the workshop.
basicWriting: Fill in a hazard or near-miss report form.
toolsEquipmentMaterials: Personal protective equipment (safety glasses, gloves, safety shoes)
safetyOSH: Never work on live equipment unless the procedure allows it and you are authorised.
Keep exits and fire extinguishers clear at all times.
performanceCriteria: Hazards are identified and reported before work starts.
PPE is selected and worn correctly throughout the task.
Tools and equipment are checked and safe before use.
Work is carried out in line with safety procedures and regulations.
Incidents and near misses are reported promptly using the approved form.
The work area is left clean, safe and tidy.
commonErrorsTroubleshooting: Starting work without checking the area for hazards.
Wearing PPE only for part of the task.
Not reporting near misses because nobody was hurt.
duty_1_1.conditionsWorkEnvironment: Computer maintenance workshop or the customer's premises, with mains power, good lighting and an ESD-safe bench.
duty_1_1.performanceStandard: Every safety step is applied before and during the work, with no incident and nothing left unsafe at the end.

decisionTable.cue: A new hazard appears or a guard, PPE or tool is found unsafe
decisionTable.error: Injury to yourself or others, damage to equipment
decisionTable.expert: Stops at once, makes the area safe and reports before restarting

performanceSteps: List the parts and components needed.
basicMath: Calculate quantities, cable lengths and percentages for spares.
performanceCriteria: All needed parts are listed.
Quantities are correct.
Compatibility is checked.
commonErrorsTroubleshooting: Forgetting small items such as screws and connectors.
duty_6_1.performanceStandard: Parts list complete and correct before the job starts.
